text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I am so sorry... For making you 
treat me to toilet air freshener.

"Living alone, Furioso always has things 
she needs. On the way home from buying 
daily necessities in the shopping 
district..."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up! Come try the fun, exciting 
lottery draw! Hey, sharp-looking Umamusume 
over there, wanna give it a spin?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation. If 
possible—I would love to do it.

If asked whether it was possible or 
impossible, it was possible.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure? Those are your lottery 
tickets, Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Yeah, because this is Funabashi's 
challenge!

Yeah, because this is a challenge for 
Funabashi!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: As Funabashi's...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
—Indeed. If you put it that way, as the 
two representatives of Funabashi, let's 
take on the lottery together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
T-Those two sure have quite the dynamic, 
huh... Good luck, though!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Now Trainer, please take hold of the 
lottery machine's lever.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Let us turn it while singing "that song."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Let's go! FuwaFuwa!

I spin the lottery raffle wheel alongside 
the famous cheer from Funabashi 
Racecourse.
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —The grand prize?! All right!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we did it! Together, we won the 
greatest prize of all...!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: This is... Funabashi's victory...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Then the prize belongs to Funabashi City.

One must strictly separate emotion from 
ownership. The prize belongs to us.
choice_data_list:
You won it, Furioso, so you can go ahead 
and use it.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You're right. If the Trainer 
who gave me the ticket says so.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let us go together. ...It has 
been a long road to get here.

"It's not as though I intended to run down 
a path of raffles, but..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Once upon a time... there was a hot spring 
facility near Funabashi Racecourse as 
well. However...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It is no longer there. Our generation 
couldn't even manage to drop by...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
We can really go, can't we? Finally, to 
the hot springs I've dreamed of!
choice_data_list: I see, so that's what it is.
I see, so that's how it is...

text_block_list.text:
A long-cherished wish transcending time. 
Should you produce results in the Twinkle 
Series, an enormous reward awaits.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can go, I won't ask for much. 
It doesn't even need to be an extravagant 
trip.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I hope we can make this a trip where we 
can truly savor that joy to make up for 
it."

Furioso doesn't care for flashy things, 
yet her heart leapt with immense 
excitement nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is...! You've won something 
quite incredible.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There's a big carrot in the center... In 
the center...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
――! That is correct. I have a splendid 
idea.
And so, returning to my room—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer. Here 
is the NEW "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak".

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I ate the carrot in the center and 
replaced it with one from Funabashi. After 
all, Funabashi carrots are renowned for 
being delicious.
choice_data_list: Oh, you got an update, huh?

text_block_list.text:
It became a hamburg steak that felt more 
true to ourselves. While worshipping the 
producers...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Well then, gratefully. Bon appétit.

And so, we thoroughly enjoyed the NEW 
Hamburg steak with a taste of home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This amount... is very much appreciated. 
It really helps with food expenses. And 
besides...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"With this much, it looks like I can try 
out all the different things I wanted to 
do."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, since you're here, would you mind 
giving this a taste test?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
My home cooking has been improving by 
leaps and bounds lately. Would you mind 
giving it a taste?
choice_data_list:
I see. In that case, I'll take you up on 
that.

I see. In that case, I think I'll have 
some.

text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up joining Furioso in her 
culinary research.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Um, this one is "Marinated Carrots," and 
this one is an Okinawan dish called 
"Carrot Shirishiri."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

The prep work really shines through. You 
can't bring out this flavor without 
meticulous cooking.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm glad to hear it was to your 
liking.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I made a few other things as well, so 
please, have a try!

And so, the two of us thoroughly enjoyed a 
full-course carrot meal.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Only one, is it...? That's a bit 
disappointing, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer. Using this carrot, there is 
something I can do."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, blind carrot tasting. With just one 
bite, I can tell whether it's from 
Funabashi or not.

I feel like I heard somewhere that it's 
possible. If it really can be done, that's 
quite an impressive skill, but...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes!
(*crunch, crunch, crunch...*)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Understood.
choice_data_list: Impressive! So, what was the result?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't produced in Funabashi... 
unfortunately.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Could they be losing ground to other 
producing regions...?

"Although I made good use of my special 
skill, it didn't really lead to anything. 
All it did was fill my stomach a little."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
A blank ticket... is it...? I feel as 
though I've brought shame upon Funabashi's 
name.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Well, you can never have too many tissues. 
I'll take them home and use them.
choice_data_list: True, it wouldn't really be a problem...
Yeah, we won't be in any trouble...

text_block_list.text:
"For Furioso living on her own, they're 
absolute necessities, but..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I have a lot of pocket tissue 
packs in my room. I kept taking them 
thinking it would save money, and ended up 
with far too many.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was in Funabashi, I wasn't 
like this. It feels like I'm turning into 
a bit of a penny-pincher...

Furioso's expression clouded over 
slightly.
